notes: Swipe to reply works now: start anywhere on the message's line, either direction.
Long-press shows the reactions, and Edit on your own messages.
Swipe a message to the right to reply (to the left in Arabic).
Tap + on the reactions for 24 more: angry, sad, broken heart, middle finger, rat and more.
Arabic: arrows point the right way everywhere, plus small layout fixes.
Fixed: long-press on a message shows the reactions and Reply / Edit again.
Tap the Hosting a game notification to go back to your room.
Opening a chat from the list is smooth now (no flash).
Messages show at once with a clock, then a tick; Not sent? Tap to retry.
Edit your messages for 15 minutes.
Long-press a message: reactions and Reply / Edit right next to it.
Smoother chat: slides in and out, no flashing.
Mentions in the notification bell, and a tidier bell.
New version alerts: a notification (11:00-17:00) and a Telegram message.
New chat: reactions, replies and @mentions; Back and Minimize buttons.
The host's Ping everyone reaches players again.
Invite an online friend from Home and a room opens for you.
Back on Home asks before closing; the narrator stops when you leave a room.
Fixes: Settings > profile > Back, see-through avatars on the friends tab.
A new app icon: the Mafia in his fedora, eyes glowing, looming over the town. It now fits your phone's icon shape.
The welcome waits on its last screen until you tap.
The welcome is now off by default (it still plays once for new players); turn it on in Settings.
The welcome now has sound: the town, the night, the blade, the Doctor, the Detective and the Mafia’s laugh, with a mute button.
Blood splashes and runs down the screen in the killing scene.
The first time you see the welcome it plays in full; after that you can skip it.
A short welcome tells the story of the town before every game (tap to move on, Skip to go straight in).
Release notes are now bullet points, with a What’s new screen.
You can turn the welcome off in Settings, and watch it again from How to Play.
When a friend lets you in after you ask to join, you see “X let you in” and join by yourself.
Friends already in your room show “In your room” instead of Invite.
The screen behind the friends list, notifications and chat no longer scrolls.
From the next update on, installing finishes without Android’s extra “Done / Open” screen.
Minimize a room from the lobby and come back with the bar at the top.
Invites now drop in at the top of the screen.
The notification bell keeps the last 24 hours, with what you did for each one.
New Friends screen: tabs, online status and quick Invite / Ask to join.
Notification bell for invites, join requests and friend requests.
Invite or ask again after 5 seconds.
Telegram invites are now a link that opens the app.
Role counts stop at their limits; fixes for the Noir tutorial, the Rules presets and Home scrolling.
Chat: the keyboard stays open, long chats scroll back, Arabic types right to left.
Online: Host first, then the room code; Join only works with exactly 6 digits.
Ask to join a friend’s online room.
Room chat: everyone and private messages, nothing saved.
Add friends from a game’s history and from the chat.
Drag the friends tab up or down; new profile menu, language flag and theme icon.
Offline game, Wi-Fi / Hotspot and Online are now the three buttons on Home.
The friends tab moved to the top of the screen.
